static_findings.snippet: Python projects use **uv workspaces** (similar to pnpm workspaces for JS) with manual `project.json`
**Key Insight**: uv manages Python deps via workspace, Nx orchestrates tasks. Single `uv.lock` at ro
| Run all tests | `pnpm nx run-many -t test` |
| Generate JS/TS app | `pnpm nx g @nx/next:app name` |
| Generate JS/TS lib | `pnpm nx g @nx/js:lib name` |
| Init Python project | `cd apps/name && uv init` |

content.user_title: Manage Nx Monorepos with Reliable Workflows
content.value_statement: Large Nx workspaces make dependency analysis, task selection, caching, and project generation difficult. This skill provides practical Nx and uv workflows for consistent monorepo operations.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to inspect project graphs, dependencies, and affected projects with Nx commands.
Provides commands for building, testing, linting, and running tasks across selected projects.
Guides application and library generation for Next.js, React, JavaScript, and TypeScript projects.
Shows local cache, Nx Cloud, cache input, and CI configuration patterns.
Documents Python application and library integration through uv workspaces and Nx project targets.
limitations: Requires an existing Nx workspace and locally installed project dependencies.
Provides guidance and command examples but does not include executable automation scripts.
Python integration uses manual project.json configuration rather than an Nx Python plugin.
Workspace names, package choices, branches, and CI settings must be adapted before use.

use_cases.title: Analyze Workspace Impact
use_cases.description: Identify affected projects and choose focused build, test, or lint tasks before opening a pull request.

use_cases.title: Standardize Monorepo CI
use_cases.description: Configure affected-only checks, cache behavior, and task dependencies for a growing Nx workspace.

use_cases.title: Integrate Python Projects
use_cases.description: Add uv-managed Python applications or libraries while preserving Nx task orchestration.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect My Workspace
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Nx workspace structure. Show the commands needed to list projects and inspect the dependency graph without changing files.

prompt_templates.title: Run Affected Checks
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan affected lint, test, and build checks between {base_branch} and {head_ref}. Explain each command and expected output.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Shared Library
prompt_templates.prompt: Design steps to add a {language} library named {library_name}. Include generation, dependency boundaries, graph verification, tests, and a dry run.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Monorepo Execution
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Nx task configuration for cache correctness and CI efficiency. Identify unstable inputs, missing dependencies, and affected-command risks. Propose verified changes.

output_examples.input: Which projects changed since the main branch?
output: Fetch the main branch so the comparison base is current.
List affected projects before running any task.
Run build, test, or lint only for the reported projects.

output_examples.input: Add a Python service to this Nx workspace.
output_examples.output: Create the service under apps, initialize it with uv, register it in the root workspace, define Nx targets, then verify the graph.

output_examples.input: Why does my Nx cache miss in CI?
output_examples.output: Compare declared inputs with generated files, environment-dependent values, lockfiles, and dependency outputs. Then confirm the target is cacheable and consistently invoked.

best_practices: Preview generators with a dry run and review all planned file changes.
Use affected commands with explicit base and head revisions in CI.
Keep cache inputs stable and declare task dependencies and outputs accurately.
anti_patterns: Do not run every project task when affected detection provides a reliable smaller scope.
Do not clear the Nx cache before investigating configuration or input instability.
Do not add Python projects without registering workspace membership and Nx targets.

faq.question: Does this skill install Nx or project dependencies?
faq.answer: No. It provides commands and configuration guidance for an existing workspace.

faq.question: Can it analyze affected projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents project listing and affected commands with explicit Git comparison revisions.

faq.question: Does it support Nx Cloud?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers connection, remote cache verification, and cache input concepts.

faq.question: Can it generate applications and libraries?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides Nx generator examples for Next.js, React, JavaScript, and TypeScript projects.

faq.question: How does it support Python projects?
faq.answer: It combines uv workspace dependency management with manually defined Nx project targets.

faq.question: Will the examples match every repository?
faq.answer: No. Replace project names, paths, branches, plugins, and CI settings with values from your workspace.
